headquarter.zh: 把總部設在（常用被動 be headquartered in）

ex.en: The company is headquartered in Taipei.
ex.zh: 這家公司總部設在台北。

ex.en: Many tech firms are headquartered in California.
ex.zh: 許多科技公司的總部設在加州。

ex.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
ex.zh: 總部裡的氣氛不太一樣。

ex.en: I have a meeting at headquarters tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要去總公司開會。

ex.en: The government plans to spend more on healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府計畫增加醫療保健支出。

ex.en: She works in the healthcare industry.
ex.zh: 她在醫療產業工作。

ex.en: Tom is hesitant to visit Mary in the hospital.
ex.zh: 湯姆對要不要去醫院探望瑪麗有點猶豫。

ex.en: Why did he remain hesitant?
ex.zh: 他為什麼還是猶豫不決？

ex.en: Don't be hesitant to ask questions.
ex.zh: 有問題不要猶豫，儘管問。

ex.en: Tom is wearing headphones.
ex.zh: 湯姆戴著耳機。

ex.en: Everybody was wearing headphones.
ex.zh: 每個人都戴著耳機。

ex.en: I always wear headphones on the subway.
ex.zh: 我搭捷運時總是戴著耳機。

ex.en: The heater is broken.
ex.zh: 暖氣機壞了。

ex.en: The heater doesn't work.
ex.zh: 暖氣機不能用了。

ex.en: Could you turn on the heater? It's freezing.
ex.zh: 可以開一下暖氣嗎？好冷喔。

ex.en: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.
ex.zh: 騎機車不戴安全帽很危險。

ex.en: You have to wear a helmet to protect your head.
ex.zh: 你得戴安全帽來保護頭部。

ex.en: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.
ex.zh: 她一戴上安全帽，就覺得安全多了。

ex.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
ex.zh: 本公司 ACME 有限公司特此聲明，我們將全力抵制這項惡意收購。

ex.en: I hereby resign from my position as manager.
ex.zh: 我特此辭去經理一職。

ex.en: You are hereby notified of the change in policy.
ex.zh: 特此通知您政策有所變更。

ex.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地把自己的車賣了。

ex.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
ex.zh: 猶豫了一會兒之後，他把書放在桌上。

ex.en: She accepted the job offer without hesitation.
ex.zh: 她毫不猶豫地接受了這份工作。

ex.en: Try to eat a healthful diet.
ex.zh: 盡量吃得健康。

ex.en: Walking is a healthful habit.
ex.zh: 散步是有益健康的習慣。

ex.en: The cat got through the hedge.
ex.zh: 貓從樹籬鑽了過去。

ex.en: We need to trim the hedge this weekend.
ex.zh: 我們這週末得修剪樹籬。

ex.en: Gold is often seen as a hedge against inflation.
ex.zh: 黃金常被視為對抗通膨的避險工具。

ex.en: Many people buy property as a hedge against rising prices.
ex.zh: 很多人買房子來對抗物價上漲。

ex.en: The company hedges against currency risk.
ex.zh: 公司對匯率風險進行避險。

ex.en: Investors hedge their bets by buying different assets.
ex.zh: 投資人買進不同的資產來分散風險。

ex.en: They were rescued by helicopter.
ex.zh: 他們被直升機救起。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
ex.zh: 我看到一架直升機從頭頂飛過。

ex.en: He is the heir to a large fortune.
ex.zh: 他是一大筆財產的繼承人。

ex.en: She is seen as the natural heir to the CEO.
ex.zh: 大家都認為她是執行長的不二接班人。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
ex.zh: 「這就是我在找的東西！」他大叫。

ex.en: He works in the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他在行銷部工作。

ex.en: What would you like to do while you're here?
ex.zh: 你在這裡的時候想做什麼？

ex.en: Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
ex.zh: 你知道這附近有什麼好餐廳嗎？

ex.en: Would you mind my staying here for some time?
ex.zh: 你介意我在這裡待一會兒嗎？

here.zh: here is / here you are：（遞東西時）這是…、給你

ex.en: Here you are, your boarding pass.
ex.zh: 給您，這是您的登機證。

ex.en: Here is your change, sir.
ex.zh: 先生，這是找您的錢。

ex.en: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
ex.zh: 我聽得到你，但看不到你。

ex.en: Did you hear that noise?
ex.zh: 你有聽到那個聲音嗎？

ex.en: Hearing the news, he jumped out of his chair.
ex.zh: 他一聽到消息就從椅子上跳了起來。

ex.en: We hadn't so much as heard of her name.
ex.zh: 我們連她的名字都沒聽過。

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快收到你的回音。

ex.en: Have you heard from Amy lately?
ex.zh: 你最近有艾咪的消息嗎？

ex.en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
ex.zh: 在太陽底下要遮住頭。

ex.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
ex.zh: 護士輕輕地幫我的頭纏上繃帶。

ex.en: She is the head of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 她是行銷部的主管。

ex.en: The head of the company will visit us next week.
ex.zh: 公司負責人下週會來拜訪我們。

ex.en: Tom told me that he was headed home.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我說他要回家了。

ex.en: Where are you heading?
ex.zh: 你要去哪裡？

ex.en: Amy heads the new project team.
ex.zh: Amy 負責帶領新的專案團隊。

ex.en: The committee is headed by our CEO.
ex.zh: 這個委員會由我們的執行長領導。

ex.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
ex.zh: 為了健康，我戒菸了。

ex.en: Parents have responsibilities to look to their children's health.
ex.zh: 父母有責任照顧孩子的健康。

ex.en: He did it at the expense of his health.
ex.zh: 他犧牲自己的健康完成了這件事。

ex.en: Our company offers health insurance to all employees.
ex.zh: 我們公司為所有員工提供健康保險。

ex.en: She works in public health.
ex.zh: 她在公共衛生領域工作。

ex.en: He died of a heart attack on the stage.
ex.zh: 他在舞台上心臟病發過世。

ex.en: Exercise is good for your heart.
ex.zh: 運動對心臟有益。

ex.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
ex.zh: 我打從心底感謝你。

ex.en: She has a kind heart.
ex.zh: 她心地善良。

ex.en: I learned English words by heart all day yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天一整天都在背英文單字。

ex.en: I know the song by heart.
ex.zh: 我會背這首歌。

ex.en: The hotel is in the heart of the city.
ex.zh: 飯店位於市中心。

ex.en: Let's get to the heart of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們直接切入問題的核心吧。

ex.en: I can't lift a suitcase heavier than 30 kilos.
ex.zh: 我提不動超過三十公斤的行李箱。

ex.en: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
ex.zh: 那個袋子太重了，我搬不動。

ex.en: Which is the heavier of the two?
ex.zh: 兩者之中哪一個比較重？

heavy.zh: 大量的、嚴重的（交通、雨等）

ex.en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
ex.zh: 大部分死於吸菸的人並不是重度吸菸者。

ex.en: Traffic is heavy during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段交通很壅塞。

ex.en: Heavy rain is expected this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午預計會有大雨。

ex.en: I can't put up with the heat any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了這種熱了。

ex.en: My father does not like the heat of summer.
ex.zh: 我爸爸不喜歡夏天的炎熱。

ex.en: The heat in the kitchen was unbearable.
ex.zh: 廚房裡熱得受不了。

ex.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
ex.zh: 把水加熱不會改變它的化學成分。

ex.en: No matter how cold it is outside, the rooms are comfortably heated.
ex.zh: 不管外面多冷，房間裡都很溫暖舒適。

ex.en: Can you heat up the soup for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把湯熱一下嗎？

ex.en: I'm cold. Would you mind turning the heating on?
ex.zh: 我好冷，你介意開暖氣嗎？

ex.en: We had a heated discussion about it.
ex.zh: 我們針對這件事進行了激烈的討論。

ex.en: When learning Chinese, pinyin is very helpful for beginners.
ex.zh: 學中文時，拼音對初學者很有幫助。

ex.en: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
ex.zh: 如果你能幫我做那件事，會很有幫助。

ex.en: Thank you, your advice was very helpful.
ex.zh: 謝謝，你的建議很有幫助。

helpful.zh: 樂於助人的、幫得上忙的

ex.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
ex.zh: 他也許很聰明，但不太幫得上忙。

ex.en: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.
ex.zh: 飯店員工親切又樂於助人。

ex.en: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
ex.zh: 通往地獄的路是由善意鋪成的。

ex.en: I also think 'living hell' is putting it too strongly.
ex.zh: 我也覺得說成「人間地獄」有點太誇張了。

ex.en: Working there was hell.
ex.zh: 在那裡工作簡直是地獄。

ex.en: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
ex.zh: 因此，我們必須照顧好自己。

ex.en: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
ex.zh: 他為了活下來什麼都做了，因此他從來不想談這件事。

ex.en: The product is handmade, hence the high price.
ex.zh: 這項產品是手工製作的，所以價格較高。

ex.en: He dreamed of being a hero.
ex.zh: 他夢想成為英雄。

ex.en: Heroes arise in troubled times.
ex.zh: 亂世出英雄。

ex.en: The hero of the movie is a young doctor.
ex.zh: 這部電影的男主角是一位年輕醫生。

ex.en: In the end, the hero saves the city.
ex.zh: 最後，男主角拯救了這座城市。

ex.en: It has been raining heavily for three hours.
ex.zh: 大雨已經下了三個小時。

ex.en: It was raining heavily when I got up this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上起床時雨下得很大。

ex.en: Bill hates that his father smokes heavily.
ex.zh: 比爾很討厭他爸爸菸抽得很兇。

ex.en: The company relies heavily on exports.
ex.zh: 這家公司非常依賴出口。

ex.en: The city was heavily damaged by the earthquake.
ex.zh: 這座城市在地震中嚴重受損。

ex.en: My little brother and I are the same height.
ex.zh: 我弟弟和我一樣高。

ex.en: What is the average height of the players?
ex.zh: 選手們的平均身高是多少？

ex.en: The height of the building is 100 meters.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓高 100 公尺。

ex.en: Tom is afraid of heights.
ex.zh: 湯姆有懼高症。

ex.en: Something you should know about me is that I'm afraid of heights.
ex.zh: 關於我，有件事你應該知道：我怕高。

ex.en: The hotel is full at the height of summer.
ex.zh: 盛夏時節飯店都客滿。

ex.en: She was at the height of her career.
ex.zh: 她當時正處於事業的巔峰。

ex.en: I hesitated about which road to take.
ex.zh: 我猶豫著不知道該走哪條路。

ex.en: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
ex.zh: 他在門前走來走去，猶豫著要不要進去。

ex.en: She hesitated before answering the question.
ex.zh: 她猶豫了一下才回答問題。

hesitate.zh: don't hesitate to：儘管、別客氣（做某事）

ex.en: Please don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請儘管與我聯絡。

ex.en: Don't hesitate to ask for help.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙的話別客氣。

ex.en: DNA has the shape of a double helix.
ex.zh: DNA 呈雙螺旋結構。

ex.en: The staircase rises in a helix.
ex.zh: 樓梯呈螺旋狀往上延伸。

ex.en: Hepatitis B is common in some parts of Asia.
ex.zh: B 型肝炎在亞洲部分地區很常見。

ex.en: You should get vaccinated against hepatitis before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前你應該先接種肝炎疫苗。

ex.en: Farmers spray herbicide to kill weeds.
ex.zh: 農民噴灑除草劑來除掉雜草。

ex.en: This vegetable was grown without herbicides.
ex.zh: 這種蔬菜種植時沒有使用除草劑。

ex.en: It has been a hectic week at the office.
ex.zh: 這一週辦公室裡忙得不可開交。

ex.en: My schedule is too hectic to take a vacation right now.
ex.zh: 我現在行程太滿，沒辦法休假。

ex.en: The airport is always hectic before the holidays.
ex.zh: 連假前機場總是一片忙亂。

ex.en: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
ex.zh: 剛出生的小牛跟不上逃離美洲豹的牛群。

ex.en: A herd of cows was walking across the field.
ex.zh: 一群牛正走過田野。

herd.zh: 把……趕在一起、帶領（一群人）

ex.en: The guide herded the tourists onto the bus.
ex.zh: 導遊把遊客趕上巴士。

ex.en: Teachers herded the children into the hall.
ex.zh: 老師們把孩子帶進禮堂。

ex.en: Having a slight headache, I went to bed early.
ex.zh: 我有點頭痛，所以早早就上床睡覺了。

ex.en: Tom told us that he had a headache.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我們說他頭痛。

ex.en: A cup of coffee relieved me of my headache.
ex.zh: 一杯咖啡讓我的頭痛舒緩了。

ex.en: Finding a parking space downtown is a real headache.
ex.zh: 在市區找停車位真的很令人頭痛。

ex.en: The new software has been a headache for everyone.
ex.zh: 新軟體讓每個人都很頭痛。

ex.en: I'm not as healthy as I used to be.
ex.zh: 我已經不像從前那樣健康了。

ex.en: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.
ex.zh: 他們有些人身體健康，有些人不是。

ex.en: I consider fruit to be the healthiest food.
ex.zh: 我認為水果是最健康的食物。

ex.en: Country life is healthier than city life.
ex.zh: 鄉村生活比都市生活健康。

ex.en: Europe is suffering from a record-breaking heat wave.
ex.zh: 歐洲正遭受破紀錄的熱浪侵襲。

ex.en: Stay indoors and drink plenty of water during a heat wave.
ex.zh: 熱浪期間請待在室內並多喝水。

ex.en: She hesitantly raised her hand to ask a question.
ex.zh: 她遲疑地舉起手想問問題。

ex.en: He answered hesitantly, as if he wasn't sure.
ex.zh: 他遲疑地回答，好像不太確定。

ex.en: The survey asked whether participants were heterosexual or not.
ex.zh: 這份調查詢問受訪者是否為異性戀者。

ex.en: They are a heterosexual couple with two children.
ex.zh: 他們是一對異性戀夫妻，有兩個孩子。

ex.en: The headline caught my eye this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上那則頭條吸引了我的目光。

ex.en: The story made headlines around the world.
ex.zh: 這件事登上了全球各地的頭條。

ex.en: This ring is a family heirloom.
ex.zh: 這枚戒指是家傳的寶物。

ex.en: The watch has been passed down as an heirloom.
ex.zh: 這支錶當作傳家寶代代相傳。

ex.en: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
ex.zh: 鐵橋峽谷是聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產。

ex.en: We must protect our cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護我們的文化遺產。

ex.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
ex.zh: 赤道把地球分成兩個半球。

ex.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
ex.zh: 日本位於北半球。

ex.en: The company plans to reduce its headcount by 10%.
ex.zh: 公司計畫裁減一成人力。

ex.en: Let's do a quick headcount before the bus leaves.
ex.zh: 巴士出發前我們先快速點個人數。

ex.en: The company moved its headquarters to Taipei.
ex.zh: 公司把總部遷到了台北。

ex.en: Please send the report to our headquarters.
ex.zh: 請把報告寄到我們總部。

ex.en: Please find the completed application attached herewith for your review.
ex.zh: 隨函檢附填妥的申請表，請查閱。

ex.en: We submit herewith the receipts requested by the finance department.
ex.zh: 謹隨函檢送財務部要求的收據。

ex.en: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這個箱子搬上樓嗎？

ex.en: I will help you as far as I can.
ex.zh: 我會盡可能幫你的。

ex.en: Help! Someone call the police!
ex.zh: 救命啊！快報警！

ex.en: Thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: A headhunter offered me a job at a bigger company.
ex.zh: 有個獵人頭幫我介紹了一家更大公司的工作。

ex.en: Many companies use headhunters to fill senior positions.
ex.zh: 很多公司透過獵人頭來找高階主管。
